combo_label: At the Vet's × Caves & Caving × The Blitz

entries.clue: Hobble on three legs, the sign that sends many a dog onto the table
Corrugated steel arch sunk in the garden and covered over with soil
Scenery of bare rock pavement, swallow holes and rivers that vanish
Anchor that pulls a caver's rope clear of a rub point, taking little load
Steady single note sounded once the raiders had passed over
Handled tool used to take the tips off a set of overgrown claws
Thin banded sheet hung from a cave roof, or a shop selling cloth
Iron park and garden fencing cut down from 1941 and carted off for scrap
Theatre job on the morning list, with nothing to eat beforehand
Letters on a warden's badge, standing for air raid precautions
